text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of our US inspection trip.
I want to learn as much as possible before heading back—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found my inspection buddy!
Looking forward to the next few days together♪
choice_data_list: Wait, you're a student and you're on the team?!
Wait, you're a student and you're on the team?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Well, normally it's just Trainers, but...
there's no rule saying students can't be assigned, right?
Plus, the Chairwoman approved the proposal♪
choice_data_list: I-If that's the case... I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
There's a race I've been kinda curious about.
I really wanted to watch it live and soak in the atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, I also wanna hit up my favorite hat shop.
Imported items have differences in materials and designs
when you see them in physical stores, after all—
choice_data_list: (...She's as active as ever.)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! LA really is the best, isn't it?♪
It's so vibrant, and super easy to hit up multiple racetracks!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Though having the racing museum so far away is kind of a bummer.
Tons of fans want to see the exhibits and all—
choice_data_list: Kentucky's where it's at, but yeah, it really is pretty far.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be quite the same as an actual museum, but... what if we set up something at the track to make up for it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Like placing QR codes all over the venue, so when you scan 'em, you can view exhibits and commentary tied to the racetrack right on your phone!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If we render 3D models with AR, people could look from any angle and size they want—
Boom, you get the museum vibe right on-site, right?
choice_data_list: That's awesome, sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was so much fun!
American movie theaters are so lively, you know?
Everyone just gets together and has a blast.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: In Japan, outside of cheer screenings or live concert viewings, people mostly just sit quietly and watch—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What about doing live race viewings in movie theaters?
We've had public viewings at racetracks before, but those locations are pretty limited, right?
choice_data_list: True... doing it in movie theaters would open it up to way more people!
True... doing it in movie theaters would open it up to way more people!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Right?! Also, an "Interactive 4D Screening: Relive Legendary Races from the Winning Horse Girl's Point of View!" would totally have massive demand♪
choice_data_list: Honestly, I'd want to watch that myself...!
Honestly, I'd want to watch that myself...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, here it is—! Del Mar Racetrack!
The home turf that crowns the world's strongest at the BC Classic!
choice_data_list: There are still plenty of people here even on a non-race day, huh?
There are still plenty of people here even on a non-race day, huh?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well duh, just standing in such an epic place gets your hype levels through the roof!
Like, "Holy crap, this is THE place?!"♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Everyone really does love racing after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...You know, maybe we should just go all out and build a theme park or an entire city where people can fully immerse themselves in racing♪
choice_data_list: Isn't that scale a bit too massive?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: You think so? If we pull it off, it'd totally work, and seeing it happen would be ultra-hype, wouldn't it?♪
choice_data_list: That's... well, I guess you have a point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Afterward, we inspected various other locations, and I was continually exposed to her flexible and captivating ideas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Idea after idea burst forth from her without stopping.
Yet every single one of those inspirations was rooted deeply in racing.
choice_data_list: (...She really is an incredible girl.)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad the weather cleared up today!
It's the ultimate day for race spectating♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was still time before the race we planned to watch—
On the way to the stands, I posed a question that had been lingering in my mind.
choice_data_list: Do you plan on doing business outside of racing in the future?
Do you plan on doing business outside of racing in the future?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she would likely be able to display her talents across a wide range of fields.
Thinking that, I asked her—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Nope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —An immediate, unexpected answer.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are plenty of big chances rolling around in fields other than racing.
...I've even been invited to join a few times.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
But that's not what this is about.
This is about what I cherish at my absolute core—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: The pure, burning excitement and the romance that sets my heart on fire.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...! She's zooming so fast, she crossed the finish line in a blink of an eye, daddy?!

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: What's a record break? Does it just mean she's super duper insane?!

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. In this race—with that girl's running, history was just made.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: So cool, so cool! That big sister came from all the way in the back and—she passed the girl in first!

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
She came all the way from Japan just like you, burning with the desire to win overseas.
...Come on, let's cheer for her.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: —Waaahhh! Big sister got first place! Yay, yay!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Racing gave me an endless sense of romance.
It taught me what real, genuine fervor feels like.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So... I guess you could call it giving back? 
I want to return the favor to the racing world with my own two hands.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: That blazing passion I encountered back then... No, I'm gonna create an even crazier, world-shaking innovation myself!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
To make the racing world a far more epic place—
Because I can see so many possibilities!
choice_data_list: ...That's a really huge dream.
With that mindset, you're bound to succeed!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Thanks♪ But, you know—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: It's not just a dream, it's a locked-in vision of the future!
choice_data_list: Locked in, huh... You just might actually pull it off.
Locked in, huh... You just might actually pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!
choice_data_list: Keep pushing straight through to the end—!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Grown-ups usually say stuff like "that's too hard" or "isn't that impossible?" though—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: You actually believe I can do it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: You actually believe I can do it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!
choice_data_list: Keep pushing straight through to the end—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We became so enthralled and captivated by the sheer power of the race that we completely forgot we were here on an inspection.
choice_data_list: Yeah... there really is no other world that gets your heart pumping like this.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooahh!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Before long, amidst thunderous cheers, the horse girl running in the lead crossed the finish line in gallant fashion.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Man, totally satisfied! Super glad we got to watch it live on-site♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Just you watch. I'm gonna hype up the whole world just like that too!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
For that, first comes prep work—
I'm gonna go talk to the people I set appointments with, 'kay?♪
